title: Changes figures readable in the light room
acceptance: In RISE Live's light room (Porcelain), a published Changes figure drawn in a dark theme's fixed inks (the figure kit's) is hung on the room's night, Porcelain's deep #0e1b36, where every one of its labels measures 4.5:1 or more; the 23 kit figures published from 2026-10-16 to 2026-11-02 included, without changing a published file.

A figure is marked only when the night reads better: a figure in dark fixed inks with a pale element (labels #333, a gridline #e5e5e5) stays on the cream, and a figure that draws in currentColor, alone or beside fixed inks, is never marked.
Fills and strokes are read as the layout check reads them (hex, named colours, rgb(), attribute or style property; none, transparent and paint servers ignored).
Switching rooms while a figure shows marks or unmarks it at once.
The dark room, the Reader and the card are unchanged: no figure is marked there, and no light-room rule applies.

evidence.note: Branch fix/changes-light-room-figures, local (Windows, Node 22), not pushed: npx vitest run src/components/read/figure-layer.test.js src/components/read/Chamber.figure.test.js src/live/host/venue.test.js src/components/read/Chamber.band-move.test.js src/core/quality/svg-layout.test.js: 5 files, 176 passed. Each review fix was red first (or red with its guard deleted) and green after: dark ink with a pale gridline, named and rgb() inks, the currentColor guard, the room switch (venue.test.js), the light room's CSS rules. vite build clean; first load 62.6 KB br of a 64.0 KB budget; ci-hygiene clean; system-design fails only on public/content/catalog.json, a generated file missing in this checkout.

Every published figure measured with the final code (a scratch script over origin/changes-data, drawnForAnotherGround on Porcelain's ground #f4efe6 and night #0e1b36, then svgLayoutProblems text-low-contrast): 29 figures; 23 marked, 23 of them with every label at 4.5:1 or more on the night; 6 unmarked, 6 of them reading on the cream.

Rendered by the agent in Playwright Chromium against the Vite dev server, the 2026-11-02 digest in RISE Live at 390 x 844 and 1440 x 900: in Porcelain picture-2 hangs on a #0e1b36 plate, every label legible; in the dark room no mark and no plate, as before; a dark-ink figure placed as picture-2 stays unmarked on the cream and reads; switching from the dark room to Porcelain through Settings while picture-2 shows marks it and hangs the plate. Not a human observation.
Merged into main 2026-11-06T19:09:41Z as merge commit 2734ec88.

Main CI run for merge commit 2734ec88: CI, voice-provider and production jobs succeeded; the production job (deploys this commit's built dist/ to production) completed 2026-11-06T19:17:31Z. Deployment only; not accepted, awaiting the owner's live check.

summary: A Changes figure drawn in a dark theme's fixed inks is shown in the light room on the room's night, where it reads, instead of on the cream where its labels vanished. Illustrator figures and the dark room are unchanged.
